title: CEL Environment Configuration (envConfig)
description: Schema for the -env (-environment) JSON input to `cel-expr env`, `cel-expr compile`, `cel-expr eval`, `cel-expr prompt`, and `cel-expr mcp`.

name.description: Optional identifier for the CEL environment.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the environment.

container.description: Optional protobuf package container namespace (e.g., 'google.rpc') used for resolving relative type and variable identifiers.

imports.description: Fully-qualified protobuf type names to import as simple identifiers.

protoTypes.description: Skills-only list of fully-qualified protobuf message or enum names to load into the FileDescriptorSet without altering CEL container or import resolution.

stdlib.description: Optional subset configuration for the CEL standard library.

contextVariable.description: Optional protobuf message type whose fields are exposed as top-level variables. Mutually exclusive with variables or used alongside them.

variables.description: Variables declared in the CEL environment.

functions.description: Custom functions and overloads declared in the CEL environment.

validators.description: AST validators to run during compilation.

name.description: Fully-qualified protobuf message or enum type name.

disabled.description: When true, disables the entire CEL standard library.

disableMacros.description: When true, disables standard CEL macros (has, all, exists, exists_one, map, filter).

includeMacros.description: Allowlist of standard macro names to enable.

excludeMacros.description: Denylist of standard macro names to disable.

includeFunctions.description: Allowlist of standard library functions and overloads to enable.

excludeFunctions.description: Denylist of standard library functions and overloads to disable.

overloads.description: Optional list of specific overload IDs to include or exclude.

version.description: Extension version number or 'latest' (defaults to 'latest' or 0 if omitted).

type.description: Fully-qualified protobuf message type name without type parameters.

name.description: Variable identifier, optionally namespaced with dots (e.g., 'request.path', 'user').

type.description: CEL type formatted as TypeName or namespace.TypeName with optional type parameters in angle brackets <> (e.g., 'string', 'int', 'list<string>', 'map<string, dyn>'). See type_grammar_ebnf.txt.

description.description: Optional description of the variable's meaning and expected format.

name.description: camelCase function name, either as a standalone functionName or namespace.functionName.

description.description: Optional description of what the function computes.

overloads.description: One or more type signatures (overloads) for the function.

id.description: Unique overload ID in the format function_name_type1_..._typeN for global functions or target_type_function_name_type1_..._typeN for member functions.

target.description: Receiver type name for member functions (e.g., 'string'). Omit for global functions.

args.description: Positional argument type names formatted according to type_grammar_ebnf.txt.

return.description: Return type name formatted according to type_grammar_ebnf.txt.

examples.description: Optional example CEL expressions demonstrating this overload.
